About Deosai National Park

Deosai is a rolling high plateau at around 4,142 m — one of the highest and largest alpine plains on earth, protected as a national park for the Himalayan brown bear. From late June the snow gives way to a short, intense season of wildflowers, marmots and ice-cold streams.
